ai.seo_question: What does the term 'Al-Masjoor' mean in reference to the sea in Surah At-Tur?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'al-Masjur' (the swollen/pressurized sea) in Surah At-Tur is interpreted not merely as physical fullness but as a sign of divine power over the chaotic forces of nature, often linked to the concept of 'Jahannam' (Hell) being fed by the sea. This imagery underscores the sea's role as a reservoir of divine mercy and a testament to God's ability to command the elements, serving as a reminder of the Day of Judgment where all creation will be gathered.
